examples.text: tatiyapeyyālo aniccadukkhavasena tehi'y'eva chabbīsatiyā suttehi vutto, catutthapeyyālo tiparivaṭṭavasenā'ti.
purimagamane aṭṭhārasa veyyākaraṇā, dutiyagamane chabbīsaṃ vitthāretabbāni.

27504.meaning2: belonging to the group of six

27505.grammar: card, instr pl of cha, irreg form of chabhi
27505.commentary: (JAa) chabbhī'ti catūsu pādesu gīvāya kaṭibhāge cā'ti chasu ṭhānesu.

examples.text: so bajjhataṃ pāsasatehi chabbhi, rammā vanā niyyatu rājadhāniṃ, tuttehi so haññatu pācanehi, bhisāni te brāhmaṇa yo ahāsi.

27506.meaning1: name of a royal family of serpents

examples.text: sace hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cattāri ahirājakulāni mettena cittena phareyya, na hi so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu ahinā daṭṭho kālaṅ'kareyya. katamāni cattāri? virūp'akkhaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, erāpathaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, chabyāputtaṃ ahirājakulaṃ, kaṇhāgotamakaṃ ahirājakulaṃ.
na chamāyaṃ nisīditvā āsane nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
na sayanagatassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo. yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca antamaso chamāyam'pi nipannassa sayanagatassa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.

27508.meaning1: onto the earth; on the ground; in the ground
27508.notes: instr sg of sk kṣam 'earth', the patient one

examples.text: ahaṃ middhena pakato, vihārā upanikkhamiṃ, caṅkamaṃ abhiruhanto, tatth'eva papatiṃ chamā.
yassa mūlaṃ chamā n'atthi, paṇṇā n'atthi kuto latā, taṃ dhīraṃ bandhanā muttaṃ, ko taṃ ninditum'arahati. devā'pi naṃ pasaṃsanti, brahmunā'pi pasaṃsito'ti.

27509.meaning1: thrown on the ground; tossed onto the earth

examples.text: addasā kho, bhaggava, sunakkhatto licchaviputto acelaṃ korakkhattiyaṃ kukkuravatikaṃ catukkuṇḍikaṃ chamānikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen'eva khādantaṃ mukhen'eva bhuñjantaṃ.

27510.meaning1: thrown on the ground; tossed onto the floor

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, acelo seniyo kukkuravatiko dukkarakārako chamānikkhittaṃ bhojanaṃ bhuñjati.

27512.meaningLit: rule about (teaching the Dhamma to someone while) on the ground

27513.meaning1: based on six items; rooted in six things

examples.text: timūlakam'pi catumūlakam'pi pañcamūlakam'pi chamūlakam'pi sattamūlakam'pi aṭṭhamūlakam'pi navamūlakam'pi evam'eva vitthāretabbaṃ.

27514.meaning1: is stiff; is rigid; is paralysed; (comm) is afraid

examples.text: so antaraghare nisinno samāno na chambhati na kampati na vedhati na paritassati. so achambhī akampī avedhī aparitassī vigatalomahaṃso.

27515.meaning2: stiffened, benumbed, paralysed (with fear); (but apparently understood also as) shaking

27516.meaning1: terror; paralysis; being frozen stiff with fear; trepidation

examples.text: atha kho māro pāpimā uppalavaṇṇāya bhikkhuniyā bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsaṃ uppādetu'kāmo samādhimhā cāvetu'kāmo yena uppalavaṇṇā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami
devo ca vassati devo ca gaḷagaḷāyati, ekako c'āhaṃ bherave bile viharāmi, tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato, n'atthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.

27517.meaning1: due to trepidation; because of being frozen stiff with fear

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, anuruddhā, puriso addhānamaggappaṭipanno, tassa ubhatopasse vaṭṭakā uppateyyuṃ, tassa tatonidānaṃ chambhitattaṃ uppajjeyya, evam'eva kho me, anuruddhā, chambhitattaṃ udapādi, chambhitatt'ādhikaraṇañ'ca pana me samādhi cavi.

27518.meaning1: due to the defilement of being stiff with fear and scared in nature

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā chambhī bhīrukajātikā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, chambhi-bhīrukajātika-sandosa-hetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā chambhī bhīrukajātikā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, chambhibhīrukajātikasandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

27520.meaning2: period of six months; six months

examples.text: chadhāturo ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha'y'imā, bhikkhu, dhātuyo, pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu, ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu.
kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cha'y'imā, bhikkhave, saññā, rūpasaññā, saddasaññā, gandhasaññā, rasasaññā, phoṭṭhabbasaññā, dhammasaññā.
cha'y'imāni, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiṭṭhānāni. katamāni cha?
cha'y'imāni, āvuso, āyatanāni, cakkh'āyatanaṃ, sot'āyatanaṃ, ghān'āyatanaṃ, jivh'āyatanaṃ, kāy'āyatanaṃ, man'āyatanaṃ. nāmarūpasamudayā saḷāyatanasamudayo, nāmarūpanirodhā saḷāyatananirodho
katamā ca, bhikkhave, taṇhā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, taṇhā.

27525.meaning1: six hundred yojanas in measure; approximately twelve thousand kilometres in extent

examples.text: hoti kho so, āvuso, samayo yaṃ mahāsamudde… catuyojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti, pañcayojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti, chayojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti, sattayojanasatikāni'pi udakāni ogacchanti.

27526.meaning2: six yojanas in extent; approximately one hundred and twenty kilometres in distance

27527.commentary: (DNt) challiṃ uṭṭhapetvā'ti arogassa mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato upakkamena challiyā sakalikāya, papaṭikāya vā uṭṭhapanaṃ viya arogassa sāsanadhammassa tiṭṭhato byañjanamattena tappariyāpannaṃ viya hutvā challisadisaṃ pubb'āpara-viruddhat'ādi-dosaṃ uṭṭhapetvā paridīpetvā, tādisāni pana ek'aṃsato guḷhavessantar'ādi-pariyāpannāni hontī'ti āha

examples.text: na c'eva sutte osarantī'ti suttapaṭipāṭiyā katthaci anāgantvā challiṃ uṭṭhapetvā guḷhavessantara-guḷhaummagga-guḷhavinaya-vedallapiṭakānaṃ aññatarato āgatāni paññāyantī'ti attho. evaṃ āgatāni hi rāg'ādivinaye ca na paññāyamānāni chaḍḍetabbāni honti.

27529.commentary: (KVa) uddiṭṭhā kho ayyāyo chasaṭṭhisatā pācittiyā dhammā'ti bhikkhū ārabbha paññattā sādhāraṇā sattati, asādhāraṇā channavutī'ti evaṃ chasaṭṭhisatā.

examples.text: manodvāre pana ek'ekasmim'pi vikappe ek'ūnatiṃsa katvā satañ'ca soḷasa ca honti. iti sabbā'pi tīsu dvāresu dve satāni chasattati ca cetanā.

27531.meaning2: with six parts or six characteristics

27532.commentary: (DNa) chasahassā hemavatā, yakkhā nānattavaṇṇino'ti chasahassā hemavatapabbate nibbattayakkhā, te ca sabbe'pi nīl'ādi-vaṇṇavasena nānattavaṇṇā.

examples.text: chasahassā hemavatā, yakkhā nānattavaṇṇino, iddhimanto jutīmanto, vaṇṇavanto yasassino, modamānā abhikkāmuṃ, bhikkhūnaṃ samitiṃ vanaṃ.

27533.commentary: (SNa) chasū'ti chasu ajjhattikesu āyatanesu uppannesu uppanno'ti vuccati.

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, yato kho bhikkhuno chasu phass'āyatanesu cittaṃ udujitaṃ hoti sudujitaṃ, ajjhattam'eva santiṭṭhati, sannisīdati, ekodi hoti, samādhiyati.
chasu loko samuppanno, chasu kubbati santhavaṃ, channameva upādāya, chasu loko vihaññatī'ti.

27534.grammar: card, loc pl of cha, irreg form of chasu

examples.text: evaṃ mano chassu yadā subhāvito, phuṭṭhassa cittaṃ na vikampate kvaci, te rāgadose abhibhuyya bhikkhavo, bhavattha jātimaraṇassa pāragā'ti.
evam'eva kho, āvuso, bhikkhu chassu phass'āyatanesu n'eva attānaṃ n'āttaniyaṃ samanupassati.

27535.meaning1: low; base; vile; wretched; poor; terrible
27535.commentary: (SNa) ke ca chave siṅgāle'ti ko ca lāmako siṅgālo.

examples.text: sīho'ti attānaṃ samekkhiyāna, amaññi kotthu migarāj'āham'asmi, tath'evaso siṅgālakaṃ anadi, ke ca chave siṅgāle ke pana sīhanāde'ti.

kiñ'hi sobhati chavo manodaṇḍo imassa evaṃ oḷārikassa kāyadaṇḍassa upanidhāya! atha kho kāyadaṇḍo'va mahāsāvajjataro pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, no tathā vacīdaṇḍo, no tathā manodaṇḍo'ti.

so sāṇāni'pi dhāreti masāṇāni'pi dhāreti chavadussāni'pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni'pi dhāreti tirīṭāni'pi dhāreti ajinam'pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam'pi dhāreti kusacīram'pi dhāreti vākacīram'pi dhāreti phalakacīram'pi dhāreti kesakambalam'pi dhāreti vāḷakambalam'pi dhāreti ulūkapakkham'pi dhāreti
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, chav'ālātaṃ ubhatopadittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ, n'eva gāme kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati, n'āraññe kaṭṭh'atthaṃ pharati.

27541.meaning1: bone of a corpse; (comm) half burned bones

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, sāriputta, susāne seyyaṃ kappemi chav'aṭṭhikāni upadhāya. apissu maṃ, sāriputta, gāmaṇḍalā upasaṅkamitvā oṭṭhubhanti'pi, omuttenti'pi, paṃsukena'pi okiranti, kaṇṇasotesu'pi salākaṃ pavesenti.
hatthibandhaṃ assabandhaṃ, gopurisañ'ca maṇḍalaṃ, chavaḍāhakaṃ pupphachaḍḍakaṃ, sadhanam'anupatanti nāriyo.

27543.commentary: (MNa) chavadussānī'ti matasarīrato chaḍḍitavatthāni. erakatiṇ'ādīni vā ganthetvā katanivāsanāni.

examples.text: so sāṇāni'pi dhāreti masāṇāni'pi dhāreti chavadussāni'pi dhāreti paṃsukūlāni'pi dhāreti tirīṭāni'pi dhāreti ajinam'pi dhāreti ajinakkhipam'pi dhāreti kusacīram'pi dhāreti vākacīram'pi dhāreti phalakacīram'pi dhāreti kesakambalam'pi dhāreti vāḷakambalam'pi dhāreti ulūkapakkham'pi dhāreti
gihibhogā parihīno, sāmaññ'atthañ'ca dubbhago, paridhaṃsamāno pakireti, chav'ālātaṃ'va nassati.

27547.meaningLit: discourse on the firebrand from a funeral pyre

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, ānanda, evam'etaṃ, ānanda dvīsu kālesu ativiya tathāgatassa kāyo parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto
tassa sīghena javena dhāvato chavim'pi ḍayhati, cammam'pi ḍayhati, maṃsam'pi ḍayhati, nhārum'pi ḍayhati, aṭṭhīni'pi sampadhūpāyanti, ubbhataṃ tādisam'eva hoti.

27549.meaning1: with skin; with a certain type of skin; with a complexion

examples.text: apissu maṃ, rājakumāra, manussā disvā evam'āhaṃsu, kāḷo samaṇo gotamo'ti, ekacce manussā evam'āhaṃsu, na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, sāmo samaṇo gotamo'ti. ekacce manussā evam'āhaṃsu, na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, na'pi sāmo, maṅguracchavi samaṇo gotamo'ti.

27551.compound: dvanda (chavi ca maṃsa ca lohita ca)

examples.text: taṃ yathā? cakkhu ca sotañ'ca cakkhusotaṃ, mukhañ'ca nāsikā ca mukhanāsikaṃ, chavi ca maṃsañ'ca lohitañ'ca chavimaṃsalohitaṃ. evaṃ pāṇy'aṅg'atthe.

27552.meaning1: accompanied by skin, flesh and blood

examples.text: evam'etaṃ, ānanda, evam'etaṃ, ānanda dvīsu kālesu ativiya tathāgatassa kāyo parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto
ekacce manussā evam'āhaṃsu, na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo, na'pi sāmo, maṅguracchavi samaṇo gotamo'ti. yāvassu me, aggivessana, tāva parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto upahato hoti tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

chah'ākārehi adiṭṭhaṃ diṭṭhaṃ me'ti sampajānamusā bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa, pubb'ev'assa hoti musā bhaṇissanti, bhaṇantassa hoti musā bhaṇāmī'ti, bhaṇitassa hoti musā mayā bhaṇitan'ti, vinidhāya diṭṭhiṃ, vinidhāya khantiṃ, vinidhāya ruciṃ.

27556.grammar: ind, card, x pl, in comps

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… akkharappabhedaṃ padaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ bhāsamaggaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ nimittaṃ chaḷaṅgaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

27557.notes: 1. śikṣā (pronunciation) 2. chandas (metre) 3. vyākaraṇa (grammatical analysis) 4. nirukta (explanation) 5. jyotiṣa (astronomy) 6. kalpa (ceremony)

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… akkharappabhedaṃ padaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ bhāsamaggaṃ uppātaṃ supinaṃ nimittaṃ chaḷaṅgaṃ… sikkhā karaṇīyā

27560.commentary: (DNa) evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu chaḷaṅgasamannāgato hotī'ti chaḷaṅg'upekkhāya samannāgato hoti. chaḷaṅg'upekkhā nāma keti? ñāṇ'ādayo. ñāṇan'ti vutte kiriyato cattāri ñāṇasampayuttacittāni labbhanti. satatavihāro'ti vutte aṭṭha mahācittāni. rajjanadussanaṃ n'atthī'ti vutte dasa cittāni labbhanti. somanassaṃ āsevanavasena labbhati.

examples.text: dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.

27563.meaning1: six species of beings; six classes of beings; six phyla; (comm) six births

examples.text: pūraṇena, bhante, kassapena chaḷabhijātiyo paññattā, kaṇh'ābhijāti paññattā, nīl'ābhijāti paññattā, lohit'ābhijāti paññattā, halidd'ābhijāti paññattā, sukk'ābhijāti paññattā, paramasukk'ābhijāti paññattā.

27565.meaning1: with six direct knowledges; having six higher knowledges
27565.meaning2: possessing the six branches of higher knowledge

examples.text: khīṇ'āsavehi suddhehi, chaḷabhiññehi jhāyibhi, cittam'aññāya buddhassa, upesi lokanāyakaṃ.

27566.meaning2: one hundred monks with six higher knowledges

27567.meaning1: six psychic powers; six supernormal abilities

examples.text: cetopariccañāṇañ'ca, sotadhātu visodhitā, iddhī'pi me sacchikatā, patto me āsavakkhayo, chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanan'ti.

27568.meaning2: having six sides or corners, hexagonal

27569.meaning1: six species of beings; six classes of beings; six phyla; (comm) six births
27569.commentary: (DNa) chaḷābhijātiyo'ti kaṇh'ābhijāti, nīl'ābhijāti, lohit'ābhijāti, halidd'ābhijāti, sukk'ābhijāti, paramasukk'ābhijātī'ti imā cha abhijātiyo vadati.

examples.text: pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca, dvaṭṭhipaṭipadā, dvaṭṭh'antarakappā, chaḷābhijātiyo, aṭṭha purisabhūmiyo, ek'ūnapaññāsa ājīvakasate, ek'ūnapaññāsa paribbājakasate

27570.meaning2: Chapter 3 of the Indriyasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: atisītan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atiuṇhan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atisāyan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atipāto'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atichāto'smī'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atidhāto'smī'ti kammaṃ na karoti.
kāmaṃ kāmesu damassu, tāva sunakho'va saṅkhal'ābaddho, kāhinti khu taṃ kāmā, chātā sunakhaṃ'va caṇḍālā.
so aparena samayena chātakabhaye sampatte yathānikkhittaṃ dhaññaṃ paribhuñjanto koṭṭhesu ca cāṭiādīsu ca nikkhittadhaññe parikkhīṇe parijane pakkosāpetvā āha.
ch'ātirekāni kho, ānanda, pañcasatāni ñātike upāsakā kālaṅ'katā tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sot'āpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyaṇā.

27576.commentary: (ANa) ghāsacchādo labbhatī'ti yasmiṃ kule dukkhena yāgubhattaghāso ca kopīnamattaṃ acchādanañ'ca labbhati.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.
sītavātaparittānaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itarītare.

27579.commentary: (MNa) ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmī'ti ghāsamattañ'c'eva acchādanamattañ'ca paramaṃ katvā viharāmi, tato paraṃ n'atthi, na ca patthemī'ti dīpeti.

examples.text: idha me, bho gotama, yaṃ ahosi dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā sabbaṃ taṃ puttānaṃ dāyajjaṃ niyyātaṃ, tatth'āhaṃ anovādī anupavādī ghāsacchādanaparamo viharāmi.
mahāpurisassa hi dakkhiṇakaṇṇacūḷikato paṭṭhāya maṃsapaṭalaṃ uṭṭhahitvā sakalanalāṭaṃ chādayamānaṃ pūrayamānaṃ gantvā vāmakaṇṇacūḷikāyaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ, taṃ rañño bandha-uṇhīsapaṭṭo viya virocati.

27584.synonym: āvaṭa, āvuṭa, oguṇṭhita, guḷha, nilīna, paṭicchanna, līna, saṃvuta
27584.commentary: (UDa) taṇhāchadanachāditā'ti taṇhāsaṅkhātena chadanena sevālapaṇakena viya udakaṃ chāditā, paṭicchannā pihitā'ti attho.

examples.text: kām'andhā jālasañchannā, taṇhāchadanachāditā, pamattabandhunā baddhā, macchā'va kumināmukhe, jarāmaraṇam'anventi, vaccho khīrapako'va mātaran'ti.

27586.meaning1: should be covered; should be concealed; should be hidden
27586.meaning2: should be covered; should be concealed; should be hidden

examples.text: so tena kammena divaṃ samakkami, sukhañ'ca khiḍḍāratiyo ca anvabhi, tato cavitvā punarāgato idha, kos'ohitaṃ vindati vatthachādiyaṃ.

27587.meaning1: could be encompassed; could be covered (with)

examples.text: sattaratanaṃ vā, āvuso, nāgaṃ aḍḍh'aṭṭhamaratanaṃ vā tālapattikāya chādetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo me cha abhiññā chādetabbaṃ maññeyyā'ti.

27588.synonym: apanidheti, āvuṇāti, niguhati, paṭicchādeti, pariguhati, parigūhati, pidahati

examples.text: sudassaṃ vajjam'aññesaṃ, attano pana duddasaṃ, paresaṃ hi so vajjāni, opunāti yathā bhusaṃ, attano pana chādeti, kaliṃ'va kitavā saṭho.
kappiyaṃ taṃ ce chādeti, cīvaraṃ idam'atthikaṃ, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.

27591.meaning1: (of food or drink) pleases; gives pleasure; is agreeable; appeals (to)
27591.commentary: (MNa) chādessatī'ti tañ'hi halāhalavisaṃ yattha yattha pakkhittaṃ hoti, tassa tass'eva rasaṃ deti.

examples.text: sace ākaṅkhasi piva. pivato hi kho taṃ chādessati vaṇṇena'pi gandhena'pi rasena'pi, pivitvā ca pana tatonidānaṃ maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti.
so'mhi eta'r'ahi tamhā ābādhā mutto bhattañ'ca me chādeti

27592.meaning1: to hide; to conceal; to cover

27593.meaning1: having hidden; having concealed; having covered

examples.text: maggena chādentassa dve magge adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ maggaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ. pariyāyena chādentassa dve pariyāye adhiṭṭhahitvā tatiyaṃ pariyāyaṃ āṇāpetvā pakkamitabbaṃ.
iṭṭhakāya chādentassa iṭṭhak'iṭṭhakāya āpatti pācittiyassa. silāya chādentassa silāya silāya āpatti pācittiyassa. sudhāya chādentassa piṇḍe piṇḍe āpatti pācittiyassa.
atha kho bhagavā jivhaṃ ninnāmetvā ubho'pi kaṇṇasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, ubho'pi nāsikasotāni anumasi paṭimasi, kevalam'pi nalāṭamaṇḍalaṃ jivhāya chādesi.
tesaṃ'y'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahānāgānaṃ anusikkhamānā taruṇā bhiṅkacchāpā taṃ sarasiṃ ogāhetvā soṇḍāya bhisamuḷālaṃ abbuhetvā na suvikkhālitaṃ vikkhāletvā sakaddamaṃ asaṅkhāditvā ajjhoharanti.
ayaṃ kho me, brāhmaṇa, paṭham'ābhinibbhidā ahosi kukkuṭacchāpakass'eva aṇḍakosamhā.
sace pana tvaṃ, bhoti, kumārikaṃ vijāyissasi, tassā te ahaṃ āpaṇā makkaṭacchāpikaṃ kiṇitvā ānessāmi, yā te kumārikāya kīḷāpanikā bhavissatī'ti.
